matches.name: several declarations in one layout section
matches.source:
a =
    let
        b = 1
        c = 2
    in
    b + c

matches.name: case branches and final section close
matches.source:
a = case x of
    Just y -> y
    Nothing -> 0

matches.name: nested inline and multiline sections
matches.source:
a =
    let
        b = let c = 1 in c
    in
    b

matches.name: line comment between declarations
matches.source:
a =
    let
        b = 1
        -- retained comment
        c = 2
    in
    b + c

matches.name: closing parenthesis closes a section
matches.source: a = (case x of Just y -> y)

matches.name: comma closes a record field section
matches.source: a = { first = case x of Just y -> y, second = 2 }

matches.name: let with two variables separated by unindented comment
matches.source:
isUpper =
  let
    five =
      5

  -- comment

    six =
      6
  in
    abcd

matches.name: Nested case are all closed?
matches.source:
func a b =
    case a of
        Nothing ->
            case b of
                1 ->
                    ""
                2 ->
                    ""
                3 ->
                    case b of
                        1 ->
                            ""
                        2 ->
                            ""
                        3 ->
                            case b of
                                1 ->
                                    ""
                                2 ->
                                    ""
                                3 ->
                                    ""
